mapper.select: SELECT MAX( wc.box_no ) FROM wms_carton wc WHERE wc.is_deleted = FALSE AND wc.packing_task_id = #{packingTaskId}

select wc.id boxId, wc.box_no boxNo, wcd.sku_id skuId, wcd.sku_no skuNo, wcd.pack_qty packQty, wcs.package_weight packageWeight, wcs.box_length boxLength, wcs.box_width boxWidth, wcs.box_height boxHeight, wcs.weight_unit weightUnit, wcs.size_unit sizeUnit from wms_carton wc left join wms_carton_detail wcd on wc.id = wcd.main_id and wcd.is_deleted = false left join wms_carton_spec wcs on wc.packing_task_id = wcs.main_id and wc.box_no = wcs.box_spec_no and wcs.is_deleted = false where wc.is_deleted = false and wc.packing_task_id = #{packingTaskId};
